spec.consumer_description: Clean-room TypeScript implementation reconstructed from native task-priority subsystem.

requirements.statement: Completed tasks score 0 regardless of due date or importance.
Overdue tasks gain 40 points per complete day late, capped at 120.
Tasks due within 24 hours receive 80 urgency points; tasks due within 7 days receive 35 urgency points.
Importance is clamped between 0 and 5, adding 30 points per level.
Total score is non-negative and capped at 200.

allowed_deviations: Native C pointers, integer widths, and calling conventions mapped to idiomatic TypeScript types.
stripped_glue: Binary ELF load segments, x86/x64 calling conventions, and raw memory layout omitted.

limitations: Derived from native subsystem decompilation and independent static review.
